"**The Story**" is a song released as a single by American folk rock singer [Brandi Carlile], written by [Phil Hanseroth], from her 2007 album _[The Story] "The Story (Brandi Carlile album)")_. It’s one of Carlile's best-known songs and has been included in the setlist of all of her concert tours to date.

The song was featured in _[Grey's Anatomy]_ on April 12, 2007 and is on [Grey's Anatomy Soundtrack album 3] "Grey's Anatomy (soundtrack)") (released September 11, 2007). It received renewed attention when a cover version was recorded by _Grey's Anatomy_ actor [Sara Ramirez] and included in the 2011 [musical episode]") "[Song Beneath the Song]". The track was later covered by [LeAnn Rimes] for her _[Remnants] "Remnants (LeAnn Rimes album)")_ album, and by [Dolly Parton] for the charity tribute album _[Cover Stories]_.

## Composition and recording

[[edit]&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Composition and recording")]

Twin brothers [Phil and Tim Hanseroth] have been Carlile's performing and writing partners since 2004[[1]]#cite_note-Faber-1) and "The Story" was written by Phil Hanseroth before the Hanseroths began collaborating with Carlile.[[2]]#cite_note-Chinen-2) It has a 16-bar melody.[[2]]#cite_note-Chinen-2) It was recorded in [Vancouver, British Columbia], Canada and produced by [T-Bone Burnett].[[3]]#cite_note-3) "The Story" was recorded "live to tape" with all the performers playing and singing at the same time, rather than following the usual practice of having musicians record their parts separately then combining them into a master recording.[[1]]#cite_note-Faber-1)

## Release and promotion

[[edit]&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Release and promotion")]

"The Story" was released as a single in 2007. It was [iTunes]' Download of the Week in March 2007.[[4]]#cite_note-Visakowitz-4) Carlile has performed the song live on _[The Tonight Show with Jay Leno]_, _[Late Night with Conan O'Brien]_ and _[The Early Show]_.[[5]]#cite_note-Scanlon-5)

## Chart performance and reception

[[edit]&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Chart performance and reception")]

In the United States Brandi Carlile's "The Story" reached No.75 on the [_Billboard_ Hot 100] chart, as well as No.35 on the Adult Pop Songs chart and No.48 on the Digital Songs chart.[[4]]#cite_note-Visakowitz-4)[[6]]#cite_note-allmusiccharts-6) The song peaked at No.44 on the Australian [ARIA Singles Chart], No.3 on the Norwegian [VG-lista] chart, No.16 on the [Swiss singles chart] and No.38 on the [Ö3 Austria Top 40] chart.[[7]]#cite_note-AusCharts-7)[[8]]#cite_note-NorChart-8)[[9]]#cite_note-ChChart-9)[[10]]#cite_note-AutChart-10)

Tom Scanlon of _[The Seattle Times]_ describes a live performance of "The Story" as "stunning" and "spine-chilling". He notes the transition within the song between acoustic pop-rock and "scream-singing" that resembles [Janis Joplin].[[5]]#cite_note-Scanlon-5) A writer for _[Indianapolis Monthly]_ also draws a comparison between Carlile's vocals and those of Joplin.[[11]]#cite_note-IM-11)_[Billboard] "Billboard (magazine)")_ and _[American Songwriter]_ ranked the song number two and number four, respectively, on their lists of the 10 greatest Brandi Carlile songs.[[12]]#cite_note-12)[[13]]#cite_note-13)
